get.summary: Planned, spent and available per budget line for a period; computed on read
get.description: Every member reads it, archived spaces included. The period's plan is reported whatever its status; without one, `plan` is null and every expense is under `unbudgeted`.

plan.description: The plan the report reads, whatever its status; null when no plan has the period.

get.summary: Assigned, contributed, consumed and gap per member and budget line for a period; computed on read
get.description: Every member reads it, viewers and archived spaces included. Reasons (NOT_ALLOCATED, TRACKED_AT_FUND_LEVEL, INVALID_ALLOCATION) and statuses (OVER_CONTRIBUTED, UNDER_CONTRIBUTED, ON_TARGET) are codes.

200.description: The lines of the period's plan, each with every current member in join order

plan.description: The plan the report reads, whatever its status; null when no plan has the period.

reason.description: Why some member figures are null: NOT_ALLOCATED (rule NONE) reports consumption only, TRACKED_AT_FUND_LEVEL (SHARED_FUND) leaves contribution and gap to the fund, INVALID_ALLOCATION assigns nobody; null when the line is allocated, valid and tracked per member.

assigned.description: Null when the line is not allocated (rule NONE), its allocation is invalid, or the allocation names no amount for the member.

contributed.description: Null when reason is NOT_ALLOCATED or TRACKED_AT_FUND_LEVEL.

consumed.description: Null on SAVINGS lines, whose spending is transfers, not shares.

gap.description: contributed − assigned; positive means the member over-contributed. Null when reason is not null or assigned is null.

status.description: The sign of gap; null when gap is null.

get.summary: Expected versus actual contributions to the shared fund per member for a period; computed on read

200.description: Every current member in join order

plan.description: The plan the report reads, whatever its status; null when no plan has the period.

totals.description: Σ over the listed members of expected, actual and difference.

get.summary: The caller's consumption and cash out in a personal period, across every space they are or were in
get.description: Only the caller's own member rows are read, a claimed guest place's history included; other members' personal spaces never appear. Shared transactions are placed by date into the caller's personal period; categories group by catalog key, a subcategory under its parent category, and a merged group takes the name the caller's personal space gives its key.

200.description: The caller's consumption by category and cash out, in the personal space's currency

key.description: The catalog key of a seeded category (HU-E3-05); null for a category users create.

space.description: The space of a custom category; null for a row merged by catalog key.

category.description: The custom category, named as the row; null for a row merged by catalog key.

get.summary: Spent per budget line over a window of periods, each versus the previous period of the space policy
get.description: Follows the lines of the end period's plan back by their origin link, else their name. Percentages are signed with two decimals; without a previous figure, or when it was 0, the status is NEW and the change and percentage are null.

200.description: The window, oldest first, and every line of the end period's plan

plan.description: The end period's plan, whose lines the trend follows; null when it has none, and then lines is empty.

period.description: The period's label, unique within the window and equal to the label of periods[i]: a derived period that shares its label with a stored one is written '<label> (<start>..<end>)'.

spent.description: Null where the line has no figure: the period has no plan, or no line of it continues this one.

change.description: Current minus previous; null when changeStatus is NEW or null.

changePercent.description: Signed percentage with two decimals, e.g. -3.70, rounded half away from zero; null when changeStatus is NEW or null, or when the change exceeds 2^53 basis points (change and status are still answered).

changeStatus.description: NEW without a previous figure or when it was 0; null where spent is null.

get.summary: The caller's consumption per personal period over a window, each versus the period before

changePercent.description: Signed percentage with two decimals, e.g. -3.70, rounded half away from zero; null when changeStatus is NEW or null, or when the change exceeds 2^53 basis points (change and status are still answered).
